name: montaj-natural-v1
input: full-range HLG-encoded BT.2020 RGB [0,1] (zscale matrixin=2020_ncl rangein=limited range=full), clipped at 1.0: Y10 64 to 940 maps to 0 to 1, the same domain as montaj-vivid-v1
output: BT.709 R'G'B' [0,1], display-referred: the values Apple's BT.709 limited-range 8-bit output decodes to, so the chain's trailing zscale only retags

reference.what: Apple's own HLG-to-SDR conversion: an AVFoundation export preset, driven by the avconvert command

method: Lossless HLG/BT.2020 test videos (libx265 Main10, tagged bt2020 / arib-std-b67 / bt2020nc / tv) carrying a 33^3 grid of flat patches at exact 10-bit limited BT.2020 NCL codes, plus off-grid validation patches and controls, each held 15 frames
The patches are laid out in three placements (raster, reversed, shuffled), each converted by avconvert; node outputs are the mean of the three, decoded from BT.709 limited 8-bit to full-range R'G'B'
Node values corrected to first order for 10-bit input quantisation (grid gradient times the decoded-minus-nominal offset), clipped to [0,1]
Validated with a tetrahedral twin of ffmpeg lut3d on 3183 off-grid patches: dE00 mean 0.22, p95 0.52; placement-to-placement noise mean 0.11 to 0.15
Adaptation checks: the conversion is static (no scene or surround adaptation within measurement noise); superwhites above Y10 940 clip to the same output as 940
Title line re-stamped to montaj-natural-v1 on promotion; data rows unchanged from the capture (apple-hlg-sdr-N33.cube)
data_sha256_of: every line after the 4-line header, newline-joined with a trailing newline

vs_apple_on_a_real_hlg_master.how: 8 frames of a real HLG master at 1080p through montaj's chain (scale, zscale, rgb48le, lut3d tetrahedral, zscale bt709 tv, yuv420p) against Apple's avconvert output of the same master; CIEDE2000 on BT.709 R'G'B' with a 2.4 display gamma

accuracy.h264_noise_floor_how: the same chain's output re-encoded with H.264 at Apple's bitrate, against itself: what the codec alone costs
